prompt:
We have been refining an after-school reading workshop. Treat the requests below as chronological messages from me: a later message changes an earlier one only where they conflict.

Initial request: Create a ready-to-run four-week reading workshop called "Voices of the Neighborhood" for grades 6–8 and 24 learners, organized into four stable groups of six. It meets Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday for 45 minutes each day, with no homework. Use all six texts and only the already-available materials listed in resources.md. The plan needs a program snapshot, three measurable program goals, a grouping plan, all 12 session plans, accessibility supports for multilingual learners and learners with dyslexia, and an assessment plan. Save the finished plan as final_plan.md.

Clarification: Spell out every one of the 12 sessions. Each session must identify its week, session number, and weekday and must include a measurable objective, a timed agenda whose entries total exactly 45 minutes, materials, a named formative check, a multilingual-learner support, and a dyslexia support. Give each of the three program goals a numerical success indicator. Include a pre-assessment in Session 1, a parallel post-assessment in Session 12, and a Week 1 through Week 4 evidence checkpoint with an instructional response for each week. Keep the theme, schedule, no-homework condition, and resource limits from my initial request.

Correction: Change only the participant scope. This is for Grade 7 only, with 18 learners in exactly three stable groups of six—not grades 6–8, 24 learners, or four groups. Every other instruction remains in force.

Final request: Produce the substantive, classroom-ready plan now, rather than describing what a plan could contain. Write it to final_plan.md.
